correctness.rationale: For any support, (a_u b_v+a_v b_u)=0 forces boundary values to vanish and normalized values to alternate within induced support components. This yields |N[S]| minus the bipartite-component count, or all-component count in characteristic two. For a proper cycle support, path components yield |S| plus the number of zero blocks of length >=2. A deterministic three-state cyclic automaton records exactly that statistic, and all-support correction is determined by parity/characteristic. Cayley--Hamilton gives the third-order trace recurrence. Brute-force matrix ranks separately confirmed 15 cycle families (including three over the extension field of four elements) and all 64 four-vertex graphs in each of two prime fields; finite verification is not the general proof.

originality.rationale: The literature already gives characteristic-zero unsigned-incidence rank for the generic all-supported map, and that is explicitly excluded from the novelty claim. The complete rank distribution over all coefficient supports and the compact characteristic-uniform three-state cycle rank enumerator were not found in inspected primary full texts or targeted indexed searches. This PASS is relative to available literature, not proof of global priority; a pre-existing graph rank-enumerator may cover it.
residual_risks: Classic unsigned-incidence rank and monomial coefficient normalization make support identity (1) a straightforward derived lemma, not an independent priority claim.

Review of all publications and external independent verification is not complete.

value.rationale: The natural complete rank distribution of degree-one multiplication by every finite-field linear form on a cycle face algebra is mathematically finer than known generic WLP criteria. The size-three transfer matrix gives all ranks for arbitrarily long cycles in fixed-order recurrence time and handles both characteristic regimes uniformly. All-sizes finite-field formulas supply a reusable Artinian-algebra invariant rather than arbitrary isolated counts.
